_about: Everything you can hold, buy, eat, give or find (sim::items). price in yen (0: not sold). full: how much it fills you (0-100 scale, a meal is about 45). energy: given back (or taken, negative). minutes: how long eating, drinking or using it takes. keeps: days it stays good (null: doesn't go off). where: where it's sold or found: the konbini, vending machines, school, home (Kenji's kitchen and fridge), Tsukumodō, the drugstore, the co-op, the shrine, festival stalls, or a shop trade from the census (bakery, tofu shop, butcher...). months: only in these months. model: the prop it uses in the world (null until one is made and approved).

items.name: Salmon onigiri
items.desc: Rice ball with grilled salmon, wrapped so the nori stays crisp.

items.name: Tuna-mayo onigiri
items.desc: Every kid's favourite.

items.name: Umeboshi onigiri
items.desc: Sour pickled plum in the middle. Wakes you up.

items.name: Kombu onigiri
items.desc: Sweet-salty simmered kelp.

items.name: Karaage bento
items.desc: Fried chicken, rice, a bit of salad nobody eats.

items.name: Hamburg steak bento
items.desc: Ask them to heat it up.

items.name: Egg sandwich
items.desc: Soft white bread, a fat layer of egg mayo.

items.name: Nikuman
items.desc: A steamed pork bun from the warmer by the till.

items.name: Fried chicken (hot snack)
items.desc: From the hot case. Best eaten walking home.

items.name: Oden (three pieces)
items.desc: Daikon, egg and a fish cake from the simmering pot. Warms you right up.

items.name: Cup ramen
items.desc: Three minutes with hot water. Needs a kettle.

items.name: Cup yakisoba
items.desc: Drain the water, not the noodles.

items.name: Melon pan
items.desc: Sweet bun with a crackly cookie crust. No melon.

items.name: Anpan
items.desc: Bread filled with sweet red bean paste.

items.name: Curry bread
items.desc: Deep-fried bun with curry inside. The bakery sells out by noon.

items.name: Yakisoba bread
items.desc: Fried noodles in a hot dog bun. Carbs in carbs.

items.name: Loaf of white bread
items.desc: Thick-cut, for toast in the morning.

items.name: Croquette
items.desc: Fried fresh at the butcher's. Kids buy them on the way home.

items.name: Menchi katsu
items.desc: A fried minced-meat cutlet, too hot to hold.

items.name: Block of tofu
items.desc: Made this morning. Kenji wants it for miso soup.

items.name: Fried tofu pouches
items.desc: For inari sushi and kitsune udon. The foxes at the Inari shrine like them too.

items.name: Fresh soy milk
items.desc: Still warm.

items.name: Mitarashi dango
items.desc: Three rice dumplings on a stick in sweet soy glaze.

items.name: Sakura mochi
items.desc: Pink mochi in a salted cherry leaf. Only in spring.

items.name: Kashiwa mochi
items.desc: For Children's Day, wrapped in an oak leaf.

items.name: Taiyaki
items.desc: A fish-shaped cake full of red bean. Head first or tail first?

items.name: Strawberry daifuku
items.desc: A whole strawberry in bean paste and mochi.

items.name: Rice crackers
items.desc: Soy-glazed and loud. Kenji keeps a tin by the till.

items.name: Umaibō
items.desc: A puffed corn stick for small change. Corn potage flavour is the best.

items.name: Kinako stick
items.desc: Dagashi: a soybean-flour toffee on a toothpick. Red tip on the stick wins another.

items.name: Ramune candy
items.desc: Fizzy tablets that melt on your tongue.

items.name: Potato chips
items.desc: Lightly salted, or seaweed salt.

items.name: Chocolate sticks
items.desc: Easy to share. Everyone takes one.

items.name: Gummy sweets
items.desc: Grape. Chewy enough to last a lesson (don't).

items.name: Soda ice pop
items.desc: Blue, icy, sticks to your fingers. Some sticks say WINNER.

items.name: Soft-serve cone
items.desc: Vanilla. Eat it before it drips.

items.name: Shaved ice
items.desc: Strawberry syrup, brain freeze included.

items.name: Yakitori skewers
items.desc: Salt or sauce, from the festival grill.

items.name: Takoyaki
items.desc: Octopus balls, molten inside. Blow first.

items.name: Festival yakisoba
items.desc: Off the big iron griddle, with red ginger.

items.name: Candy apple
items.desc: Shiny red and impossible to bite.

items.name: Bowl of ramen
items.desc: Shōyu ramen at the counter. Slurping is polite.

items.name: Kake soba
items.desc: Buckwheat noodles in hot broth, with spring onion.

items.name: Thick toast set
items.desc: Toast as thick as a book, butter and jam, at the old coffee shop.

items.name: School lunch
items.desc: Rice, soup, a main and a carton of milk, eaten together in the classroom.

items.name: Kenji's breakfast
items.desc: Rice, miso soup, grilled fish or an egg. On the table at seven.

items.name: Kenji's dinner
items.desc: Curry rice, nikujaga, yakisoba... whatever Kenji felt like. Seven o'clock.

items.name: Leftover curry
items.desc: Day-two curry is the best curry.

items.name: Natto
items.desc: Fermented beans. Stringy. Love it or hate it.

items.name: Eggs (6)
items.desc: From a farm down the road. For tamago-kake-gohan.

items.name: Rice (5 kg)
items.desc: This year's local rice. Heavy.

items.name: Miso
items.desc: For soup every morning.

items.name: Salted mackerel
items.desc: Kenji grills it for breakfast.

items.name: Sashimi pack
items.desc: Tuna and squid, for a treat.

items.name: Mikan
items.desc: Peel it under the kotatsu.

items.name: Apple
items.desc: Crisp and huge. Cut into rabbits if you're lucky.

items.name: Banana
items.desc: The breakfast you eat on the way out.

items.name: Watermelon slice
items.desc: Sprinkle salt. Spit seeds off the veranda.

items.name: Strawberries
items.desc: A pack from the greenhouses.

items.name: Persimmon
items.desc: Every farmhouse has a tree. Someone will give you a bag.

items.name: Grilled corn
items.desc: Soy sauce and butter.

items.name: Green tea (bottle)
items.desc: Cold, unsweetened.

items.name: Barley tea
items.desc: A jug in the fridge all summer.

items.name: Ramune
items.desc: Push the marble down to open it. It fizzes over.

items.name: Cola (can)
items.desc: From the vending machine by the station.

items.name: Sports drink
items.desc: What club kids drink by the litre.

items.name: Calpis water
items.desc: Milky, sweet, a little sour.

items.name: Hot corn potage (can)
items.desc: From the red (hot) row. The last kernels never come out.

items.name: Milk (carton)
items.desc: From the dairy up the valley.

items.name: Yakult
items.desc: One tiny bottle a day.

items.name: Notebook
items.desc: Ruled, for class notes.

items.name: Pencils
items.desc: A pack of HB, and an eraser shaped like a rice ball.

items.name: Textbooks
items.desc: Japanese, maths, science, English, social studies. Heavy. Study at your desk to get through them.

items.name: Your journal
items.desc: A thick notebook for your diary, what you learn about people, and your plans.

items.name: Weekly manga magazine
items.desc: Thick as a phone book. Comes out every Monday.

items.name: Manga volume
items.desc: The next volume of the series everyone at school is reading.

items.name: Card game magazine
items.desc: Deck lists, set previews, the occasional promo card taped inside.

items.name: Library book
items.desc: From the school library. Back in two weeks.

items.name: Card sleeves (60)
items.desc: Keep your best cards safe.

items.name: Deck box
items.desc: Holds a sleeved deck.

items.name: Umbrella
items.desc: Clear plastic. Everyone's looks the same.

items.name: Hand towel
items.desc: Round your neck in summer.

items.name: Fishing rod
items.desc: A cheap telescopic rod for the river.

items.name: Bug net
items.desc: For beetles and cicadas.

items.name: Bug cage
items.desc: A green plastic box with a carry strap.

items.name: Sparklers
items.desc: A summer night's worth. The senkō hanabi ones go last.

items.name: Omamori charm
items.desc: For study, health or luck. You can't open it.

items.name: Omikuji fortune
items.desc: Draw your luck. Tie a bad one to the branch.

items.name: Ema plaque
items.desc: Write a wish and hang it up.

items.name: Bunch of flowers
items.desc: For a grave at Obon, or someone's birthday.

items.name: Goldfish in a bag
items.desc: Won at goldfish scooping. Now you need a bowl.

items.name: Festival mask
items.desc: Plastic, worn on the side of your head.

items.name: Plasters
items.desc: For grazed knees.

items.name: Bath salts
items.desc: Hot-spring scent. Makes the bath better.
